title: Business Choices
author: 658dacbd63999e77f14b97fb
chapter_outcomes: Role of an entrepreneur: creating and setting up a business, running and expanding/developing a business, innovation within a business (intrapreneurship), barriers to entrepreneurship, anticipating risk and uncertainty in the business environment

Entrepreneurial motives and characteristics: characteristics and skills required, reasons why people set up businesses including financial motives (profit maximisation and profit satisficing) and non-financial motives (ethical stance, social entrepreneurship, independence and home working)
Business objectives: survival, profit maximisation, other objectives including sales maximisation, market share, cost efficiency, employee welfare, customer satisfaction, social objectives
Leadership: the distinction between management and leadership
Types of leadership style: autocratic, paternalistic, democratic, laissez-faire
The difficulty of moving from entrepreneur to leader
